newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-BIERHOFF AND BASLER LEAD GERMANY TO VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BIERHOFF AND BASLER LEAD GERMANY TO VICTORY.

text.p: Germany scored two second half goals to beat leaders Ukraine 2-0 in a hard-fought World Cup group nine qualifer on Wednesday.
Oliver Bierhoff broke open the tight, defensive match in the 63rd minute with a powerful left-foot shot from 13 metres after Juergen Klinsmann set up the chance with a header.

Klinsmann made the second goal for Mario Basler who took a pass on the left-hand side of the penalty box nine minutes later and looped his shot over Ukraine goalkeeper Olexander Kosovsky to put Germany 2-0 up.
Germany moved into second place in the group with the win, its third in five matches, and now has 11 points behind Ukraine, which leads the group with 12 points from six matches.
